title: Dallas Margs, Wine & Foodie Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers who are vegan, intolerant to gluten or dairy.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: One-of-a-kind walking tour along historic Main Street in Grapevine, Texas that includes great food, wine and other spirits from local specialty restaurants and shops, all wrapped up with a little bit of history in between tasting locations.
